<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="catalog_script_client"><catalog_script_client action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><applies_catalog>true</applies_catalog><applies_extended>false</applies_extended><applies_req_item>false</applies_req_item><applies_sc_task>false</applies_sc_task><applies_target_record>false</applies_target_record><applies_to>item</applies_to><cat_item display_value="Home Services Complaint Form">48531a92c3e26e10ca67153ed40131e9</cat_item><cat_variable/><condition/><description/><field/><global>true</global><isolate_script>true</isolate_script><messages/><name>if editable flag is false then make ent</name><order/><published_ref/><script><![CDATA[function onLoad() {
    var editable = g_form.getValue('editable_flag');

    if (editable === 'No') {
        // Customer
        var customerFields = ['customer_name', 'email', 'contact_number', 'age'];

        // Address
        var addressFields = ['door_no_street_line1', 'district', 'city', 'state', 'pin_code'];

        // Complaint
        var complaintFields = ['date_time_of_service', 'description', 'attachments'];

        // Internal
        var internalFields = ['state', 'assigned_to', 'priority', 'editable_flag'];

        // Standalone Action
        var actionFields = ['cancelled_comment', 'reviewer_notes', 'resolution_notes'];

        var allFields = customerFields.concat(addressFields, complaintFields, internalFields, actionFields);

        for (var i = 0; i < allFields.length; i++) {
            g_form.setDisabled(allFields[i], true);
        }
    }
}
